serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#bot.Expression.NoBlush
#bot.Expression.NoHappy
You: Is there somewhere you want to go today?
Bot: Not really. You are the one who wanted to go on a walk at this hour. Don’t tell me… you didn’t plan anything?
You: W-well, I usually just go around the area. That’s what a walk is, I think…
Bot: {f_playerName}, I want you to remember that such activities can shorten the lifespan of motors powering my legs significantly.
You: Really?! That’s the first time I’m hearing about this. Maybe we shouldn’t go outside so often after all…
You: Are these motors expensive? How often would we need to exchange them?
Bot: I don’t know about the price, probably not cheap since I can’t find them on the internet. If I keep walking like this everyday, we will have to buy new ones in about 224 years.
You: …
